## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.0016778199023144364336310551358776001013829401215770658599799349282716974076737897457922714197448847**. Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), with the matrix boundary at tau=2.372864 above Francois Le Gall's published omega<2.3728639 as specialised by Chafik Boukhalfa in PR1699, free strict slacks at 1e-64 or below and b = certified endpoint - 1e-64, and a NEW radix-distributed sparse-union schedule (outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md, not part of PR1673 or PR1699; executable check outer/sched_test.py) that replaces the per-axis scan of the union by flag-count rounds with stable radix distribution, a variable-length lockstep transpose and a LIFO interleave: union row eps+1/2-xi instead of eps+beta+1/2-xi, so the boundary row binds with main = fused Gaussian. The 50 strict inequalities, 7 rejecting controls (including reinstating the old g-factor union row, which fails) and the endpoint rejection are regenerated with an independent balance derivation; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses; the union schedule needs independent review; the exponent is a cited theorem.
